pr.title: chore(payments): wire the Stripe client for staging
pr.body:
Wires the Stripe client so staging can run real test charges.

For local runs add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk-live0123456789abcdefghijklmnop to your .env until the secrets manager rollout finishes.
